whoItsFor: Developers and coding-agent users (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity) who want their AI assistant to control and inspect a live Chrome browser for automation, debugging, and performance analysis.
useCases: Record Chrome performance traces and extract actionable performance insights
Analyze network requests, take screenshots, and check console messages with source-mapped stack traces
Automate browser actions reliably with Puppeteer while the agent waits for results

requirements.runtime: Node.js LTS, Chrome current stable or newer, npm
